containerImage.publishedImageLag: ecrum19/vcf-rdfizer carries version tags up to 3.0.2 (2026-09-12), which predates the corrections in 3.0.3. Pulling it reproduces the pre-correction behaviour, not the results reported.

shaclSettings.why: Without the ontology graph and RDFS inference, sh:class vcfc:Allele cannot see that AltAllele and ReferenceAllele are subclasses, and conforming data reports violations. This is the configuration the vocabulary's own tests/validate_shacl.py uses.
